scope: Proposition 2.5 (Fourier amplification) of the manuscript “From partial permutation information to Fourier bounds” (preprints/From-partial-permutation-information-to-Fourier-bounds-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 88926b5e48099ed8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let µn be probabilities on Sn with b µn(sgn) = o(1). Suppose either fn is a nonnegative subprobability with fn ≤ µn and mass tending to one, or fn is a probability with ∥fn − µn∥TV = o(1). If, uniformly for every irreducible of degree D > 1, ∥ b fn∥op ≤ AD−β , where A, β > 0 are fixed, then ∥µ∗r n − U∥TV → 0 for every fixed integer r with 2 − 2rβ < 0. If instead ∥ b fn∥2 HS ≤ AD−γ, the sufficient condition is 1 − rγ < 0.
